approach: Gate three already-mostly-true invariants: add Constitution Principle IX (verbatim FR-001 text), upgrade registry.test.ts to an exact-count assertion re-verified at 114 (not the spec's stale 101), and add a manifest-resolution test plus a scoped depcruiser rule (StudioShell.tsx + StepHost.tsx only) guarding against direct editors/ imports. No production code changes — StepHost.tsx already mediates all editor rendering.

decisions.decision: Gate FR-002 at the re-verified count of 114, not the spec's stale 101
decisions.why: registry.reserve.ts (31 modules) did not exist when spec.md was written 2026-07-06; gating on 101 would fail CI on the first run for an unrelated reason
decisions.rejected: keep 101 as literally specified and let CI discover the drift

decisions.decision: Scope the new depcruiser rule to StudioShell.tsx + components/StepHost.tsx only
decisions.why: a blanket components/ -> editors/ ban breaks OutputScreen.tsx's legitimate import of ScaffoldForm/TrackOneIdentityPanel from editors/panels/
decisions.rejected: a folder-level rule on components/, or scoping to StudioShell.tsx alone (leaves StepHost.tsx, the actual mount point, unguarded)

decisions.decision: Source-guard test matches the editors/ import path, not a Gallery|Panel name grep
decisions.why: the spec's literal grep false-positives on the legitimate UnfinishedGalleryIndicator import in StudioShell.tsx
decisions.rejected: the spec's literal grep -n import.*Gallery|import.*Panel command

decisions.decision: Reuse existing StepHost.tsx as FR-006's mediating layer; build no new registry/step-host runtime
decisions.why: StepHost.tsx (spec 028 Stage 5) already resolves manifest step to component; FR-006 explicitly forbids building a second one
decisions.rejected: a standalone resolveStepComponent() function per FR-003's literal example

decisions.decision: Wrote FR-002 gate against the re-verified 114-module count (9+49+22+3+31), not the specs stale 2026-07-06 count of 101
decisions.why: A fifth sub-registry (registry.reserve.ts, 31 modules) was added to the codebase after the spec was written; plan.md and research.md already flagged this and directed implementation to gate the current true count rather than the stale spec figure, consistent with the Assumptions sections re-verification clause
decisions.rejected: Gating at the spec-literal 101 count, which would have made the new test fail immediately on a correct, unrelated codebase

decisions.decision: Added a sibling describe block for StepHost.tsx source-guard (FR-004) rather than folding it into the existing SC-004 StudioShell.tsx block
decisions.why: The existing SC-004 block already declares src via a single readFileSync at describe-scope for StudioShell.tsx only; introducing a second file read of a different path into the same block would conflate two distinct source strings under one src variable name, which is confusing rather than reusing structure cleanly
decisions.rejected: Renaming the existing blocks variable and threading two sources through one describe body

decisions.decision: FR-003 resolution test iterates manifest and emits one it() per step (parameterized by step.id/kind) rather than a single it() looping all steps
decisions.why: A per-step it() gives a distinct failing test name naming the orphaned step id, which is faster to diagnose than one aggregate assertion failing on the first bad entry in a loop
decisions.rejected: A single it() with a for-loop and one expect per iteration, matching the literal data-model.md phrasing more directly
